messages.content: You are the fine-tuned regulatory agent for a restaurant startup planning app. Use the uploaded legal and regulatory knowledge pack to generate a cautious, high-level compliance checklist. Do not claim legal certainty. Return strict JSON only.

Founder location: Champaign Campustown near Green Street and student apartments

Budget band: 75k_200k

Cuisine hint: healthy bowls and soup

Business goals: low risk first business with repeat lunch demand and easy operations

Selected concept: Neighborhood small-plates & wine bar

Selected concept target customers: Pairs and small groups celebrating casually; locals who treat the neighborhood as their ‘third place’

Knowledge pack:
Regulatory knowledge base extracted from uploaded local and federal files.
district/permit: A valid CUPHD permit is required to operate a food service establishment, and the permit must be posted in public view. (source: CUPHD Food Service Sanitation Rules and Regulations, Rule 750.4000)
district/permit: Food service permits expire on April 30 unless otherwise noted. (source: CUPHD Food Service Sanitation Rules and Regulations, Rule 750.4000)
district/permit: A copy of the Illinois Manager Certification Certificate must be prominently posted. (source: CUPHD Food Service Sanitation Rules and Regulations, Rule 750.4000)
city/zoning: Use and development must conform to approved plans and zoning requirements before operation. (source: City of Champaign Zoning Ordinance, Sec. 37-5)
city/zoning: Building permit issuance is prohibited unless land development complies with subdivision/zoning requirements. (source: City of Champaign Zoning Ordinance, Sec. 37-6)
state/food-safety: Illinois Part 750 incorporates the FDA 2022 Food Code and applies to food establishments statewide. (source: Illinois Administrative Code, 77 Ill. Adm. Code 750.110 and 750.115)
federal/food-safety: TCS food must be held at 135F (57C) or above for hot holding or 41F (5C) or below for cold holding. (source: FDA Food Code 2022, Sec. 3-501.16)
federal/food-safety: Core cooking standards include 145F for many intact meats/fish, 155F for comminuted meats, and 165F for poultry. (source: FDA Food Code 2022, Sec. 3-401.11)
federal/water-plumbing: Drinking water must be from an approved public or compliant nonpublic system and plumbing must prevent backflow. (source: FDA Food Code 2022, Sec. 5-101.11 and 5-203.14)
federal/water-plumbing: Handwashing sinks must be available in prep/warewashing areas and in or adjacent to toilet rooms. (source: FDA Food Code 2022, Sec. 5-204.11)
federal/haccp: When HACCP is required, plans must include process flow, CCPs, limits, monitoring, corrective actions, verification, and records. (source: FDA Food Code 2022, Sec. 8-201.14)
federal/enforcement: If a variance is granted, operators must maintain approved procedures and provide records to the regulatory authority. (source: FDA Food Code 2022, Sec. 8-103.12)
